input: Find arts, music, theater, dance, STEM, academic and cooking summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Tryon, Columbus, Saluda, Lake Lure, Chimney Rock, Rutherfordton and Forest City, NC, and Landrum, SC. Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
searches: Tryon Columbus Saluda summer camp 2026 art music theater

candidates.name: Tryon Fine Arts Center
candidates.note: 2026 programs included SASY visual and performing arts camp, PacJAM music camp, and theater camp with Tryon Little Theater.

candidates.name: Tryon Little Theater
candidates.note: Co-presented the 2026 weeklong theater camp with Tryon Fine Arts Center, culminating in a staged production.

candidates.name: Tryon Arts & Crafts School
candidates.note: Summer Sizzler weekly youth art camps were listed for June 29–July 31, 2026.

candidates.name: KidSenses Children's Interactive Museum
candidates.note: 2025 full-day camps included Colorful Creations for rising K–2 students and Messy Mad Science.

candidates.name: Into The Woods
candidates.note: 2026 weekly camps included clay creations, miniature ecosystems, animal encounters, and worm farms.

candidates.name: Isothermal Community College
candidates.note: Discovery Engineering Camp ran July 6–10, 2026, with hands-on engineering activities.

candidates.name: N.C. Cooperative Extension — Polk County Center
candidates.note: 2025 Summer Sparks offered registered 4-H summer classes for youth ages 5–18.

candidates.name: N.C. Cooperative Extension — Rutherford County Center
candidates.note: 2026 4-H Summer Fun offered educational workshops, tours, and hands-on life-skills activities for ages 5–18.

candidates.name: Polk County Public Libraries
candidates.note: 2025 summer offerings included an eight-week learning program, summer storytimes, and a supervised teen painting workshop.

candidates.name: Kids Camp Landrum
candidates.note: 2025 summer camp featured themed weeks, arts and crafts, games, field trips, and daily devotions at First Baptist Landrum.
